newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian navy expels Chinese fishing boats.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian navy expels Chinese fishing boats.

text.p: Indonesia has expelled over 50 Chinese fishing boats after they intruded into its territorial waters, the official Antara news agency said on Thursday.
"The navy drove the Chinese ships away after confiscating their nets and giving their crews one-way travel documents," Indonesian Navy Chief-of-Staff Arief Kushariadi said.

Antara said the navy intercepted the boats after an operation which ended last week off the coast of Benjina in Indonesia's eastern province of Irian Jaya -- about 4,000 km (2,500 miles) east of Jakarta. The boats were flying the Indonesian flag, Arief said.
Antara quoted Arief as saying he believed that the intrusion was more than simply a fishing trip gone astray, but did not elaborate.
